Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from parents and students about our offerings, free career guidance, and support format.

What does "A Sanctuary for Young Minds" mean at NPconscious?

It means students can approach us without fear of being judged or pushed into a course. We listen first, understand what the learner needs, and support them across Mathematics, Computer Science, and free Career Guidance.

Is Career Guidance really free, and how do partner referrals work?

Yes. Basic career counselling is always free for students. When a student is ready for an external next step (such as a coaching centre, college, university, or overseas education partner) and chooses to proceed through a qualifying referral, NPconscious may earn a commission. Every recommendation is based on the student's goals, eligibility, budget, and preferences, never on commission.

What is included in Computer Science right now?

Our Computer Science track covers Python fundamentals, web basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and logical problem-solving for students in grades 8–12 in small mentor-led batches. You can view the Computer Science page or share your interest so our team can share upcoming cohort dates.

How does the Mathematics demo & assessment work?

Our Mathematics assessment is a 30-minute 1-on-1 session (1 hour for Engineering Maths) where we explore visual puzzles together to see how the student reasons and asks questions. Parents receive qualitative feedback afterward.

Which school boards do you align with, and are multiple offerings compulsory?

Our Mathematics programmes align with CBSE, ICSE, Cambridge (IGCSE), IB, and State Board standards. Offerings are never bundled as compulsory upsells: we only suggest another offering if it fits what the student needs.
